note: GoKesari Health (docs/health/), owner brief 20-Nov-2026 10.51 IST; launch mode (all Prime features free) per owner 20-Nov.

features.feature: Health hub, sign-in and role checks on every Health page and API
Prescription QR verification and expiring share links
Doctor booking, clinic Today, tokens and live queue (verified doctors only)
E-prescriptions: issue, PDF, e-mail, amend with reason, telemedicine lists, allergy warning
Lifelong health record, consent, access log, family, DPDP rights
Prescriptions to medical stores: pickup / delivery OTP, substitutes, dispensed tracking, 2% commission
Doctor suggestions and referrals with Book now (no money to doctors, NMC)
Home care: nurse, physio, massage, attendant; OTP check-in / out; notes
Medical equipment buy / rent: deposit, return, refund
Listing plans: launch mode, all Prime features free for medical shops (admin-priced plans when off)
Health admin: verification, drug master, break-glass, logs

scenarios.title: Guest access and public checks
scenarios.description: Private Health pages and APIs refuse a guest; the prescription QR check and share links show nothing private.

scenarios.title: Doctor booking, clinic Today and the live queue
scenarios.description: Only verified doctors are bookable; bookings, tokens and queue positions update live.

scenarios.title: E-prescriptions
scenarios.description: Issue, PDF, e-mail, print, QR verification, amend and the telemedicine / allergy safety checks.

scenarios.title: Health record, consent, family and privacy
scenarios.description: One lifelong record per person; doctors see it only with consent; every look is logged; DPDP rights.

scenarios.title: Prescriptions to medical stores
scenarios.description: Pickup and delivery with OTP, substitutes, dispensed quantity, no-reply fallback.

scenarios.title: Suggestions, home care and medical equipment
scenarios.description: Book now from a doctor's suggestion; home-care visits with OTP; equipment rental with deposit.

scenarios.title: Listing, referrals and Health admin
scenarios.description: Launch mode (all Prime features free), patient referrals, verification queues, drug master, break-glass.

cases.title: My Health sends a guest to sign in
cases.steps: 1. Open /health signed out
cases.expected: Redirected to /signin with callbackUrl=/health; no error page; no sideways scroll on a phone.

cases.title: Clinic Today, Health hub and settings send a guest to sign in
cases.steps: 1. Open /shop/health, /shop/health/hub, /shop/health/settings signed out
cases.expected: Each redirects to /signin.

cases.title: Prescription QR check shows 'not found' for an unknown code
cases.steps: 1. Open /rx/verify/<random 24 chars>
cases.expected: Page 200 with 'Not found'; no patient details; no error page.

cases.title: An unknown or expired share link returns no file
cases.steps: 1. GET /api/health/share/<random>
cases.expected: 404; body is not a PDF.

cases.title: Every private Health API refuses a guest (401)
cases.steps: 1. Call every /api/health/* and /api/admin/health* route signed out (public: share link, telephony webhook, doctor search, care ID)
cases.expected: Each returns 401 before reading the request; the live stream returns 401.

cases.title: Book a verified doctor (slot) — appears in Today live within 2 s
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Doctor opens /shop/health
2. Customer books the doctor for self from /health/doctors
3. Watch Today
cases.expected: The booking appears in Today without refresh within 2 seconds, with a sound; patient name, age/gender, new/follow-up, mode, reason, payment status.

cases.title: Token clinic: tokens in order and live queue position
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice). Clinic settings: token clinic on.
cases.steps:
1. Two customers book the same day
2. Reception calls #1
cases.expected: Tokens 1 and 2; customer 2 sees token 2, one ahead, then 'now serving 1' live.

cases.title: Unverified doctor cannot be booked or prescribe
cases.preconditions: Doctor with certificate uploaded but practice not verified.
cases.steps:
1. Book through Health
2. Start a consultation
cases.expected: Both refused with 'not verified'.

cases.title: Issue a prescription: PDF in record, e-mail with PDF, print, booking completed (≤ 30 s)
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Check the patient in with the QR
2. Consult, add medicines, Issue
cases.expected: Within 30 s: prescription in Timeline, By provider and Medicines; e-mail queued with the PDF attached; print view opens; booking COMPLETED.

cases.title: Prescription QR verification (public vs authorised)
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Scan the QR signed out
2. Signed in as the patient
cases.expected: Signed out: genuine + doctor + registration, no patient details. Patient: medicines and PDF fingerprint.

cases.title: Amend creates a new version with a reason; old QR says replaced
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Open an issued prescription
2. Amend with a reason
cases.expected: Version 2 issued and e-mailed; version 1 kept, its QR shows 'replaced'.

cases.title: Telemedicine: prohibited medicine blocked, List B only after in-person visit
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice). A video booking.
cases.steps:
1. Add Alprazolam
2. Add Metformin (no earlier in-person visit)
cases.expected: Both blocked with the guideline reason; issue disabled.

cases.title: Allergy warning must be acknowledged
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice). Patient allergy recorded.
cases.steps: 1. Prescribe the allergen
cases.expected: Warning shown; issue only after ticking 'reviewed'.

cases.title: Letterhead modes and calibration print
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Pre-printed mode, print calibration sheet at 100%
2. Set margins
3. Print a prescription
cases.expected: Text lands inside the blank area; digital mode shows header/footer images; e-mailed PDF always complete.

cases.title: Earlier records visible to a doctor only while consent is active; each look logged
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Doctor opens the pad (no consent)
2. Patient allows always
3. Patient withdraws
cases.expected: Hidden → visible (access log entry with the doctor's name and IST time) → hidden again.

cases.title: Lifelong record: three doctors and a nurse in date order per family member
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Visits with 3 doctors and 1 home nurse for a child
2. Open the child's Records
cases.expected: All visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, medicines, notes and reports in date order from the record start.

cases.title: Family: dependent at once, adult only after the one-time code
cases.preconditions: Health on.
cases.steps:
1. Add a child
2. Add an adult parent with mobile
cases.expected: Child active at once; adult waits until the code is entered.

cases.title: Prescription to store — pickup with OTP
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice). A verified pharmacy nearby.
cases.steps:
1. Get medicines → store → pickup
2. Store quotes
3. Approve, pay at counter
4. Ready → pickup code
cases.expected: Completed with the code; bill with batch/expiry in the record; dispensed quantities updated.

cases.title: Prescription to store — delivery with OTP and substitute approval
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice). A verified pharmacy nearby.
cases.steps:
1. Delivery
2. Store quotes one substitute
3. Patient rejects it, approves the rest, pays online (sandbox)
cases.expected: Rejected substitute drops; delivery completes with the code; settlement 2%.

cases.title: Dispensed quantity can never exceed prescribed
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps: 1. Forward the same medicine to two stores and complete both
cases.expected: The second completion is refused.

cases.title: Store does not reply in 15 minutes → patient told and offered another store
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Forward
2. Wait past the timeout
cases.expected: Order EXPIRED, notification, 'Send to another store'.

cases.title: Suggestions on the prescription: Book now for specialist, care, equipment, lab, follow-up
cases.preconditions: Rules consultBooking and health switched on (Admin → Settings); a verified doctor (Health doctor profile + verified certificate and practice).
cases.steps:
1. Doctor adds all five suggestion types
2. Patient books each
cases.expected: Each booking/order linked to its suggestion; doctor sees 'booked' only; no money to the doctor.

cases.title: Home care: book → accept → on the way → OTP check-in/out → notes in record → rating
cases.preconditions: Health on; verified home nurse.
cases.steps: Full visit
cases.expected: Visit note PDF and vitals in the record; booking completed; rating saved.

cases.title: Equipment rental: deposit, delivery OTP, return, deposit refund minus damages
cases.preconditions: Health on; verified equipment store.
cases.steps: Full rental with an extension
cases.expected: Deposit refunded less damages through the gateway; rental CLOSED; history shows it.

cases.title: Listing in launch mode: every medical shop gets the Prime features free (instant booking, Prime label, call tracking); no plan to buy
cases.preconditions: Health on; launch mode on (rule health.primeForAll, on at launch).
cases.steps:
1. Doctor opens Seller Central → Orders → Health → Prime
2. Customer searches Find a doctor
3. Missed call to the clinic's tracked number (mock)
4. Admin switches launch mode off and changes a plan price
cases.expected: 1. The page says every Prime feature is included at launch; no Buy button. 2. The doctor shows with the Prime label and instant booking. 3. The call is logged. 4. With launch mode off: plans show at the admin's new price (no code change); a purchase gives a GST invoice; after expiry and grace the shop is back on Free and its bookings are kept.

cases.title: Patient referral codes and rewards switchable by admin
cases.preconditions: customerReferrals rule.
cases.steps:
1. Share code
2. Admin switches rewards off
cases.expected: Existing referral flow; no reward when off.

cases.title: Admin: verification queues, drug master CSV, break-glass with reason (logged, patient told)
cases.preconditions: Health on.
cases.steps:
1. Operator verifies a pharmacy
2. Admin imports drugs CSV
3. Admin break-glass
cases.expected: Operator cannot break glass; break-glass needs a reason, appears in the patient's access log and audit, patient notified.

cases.title: Privacy: withdraw sharing, access log in IST, download data, delete request
cases.preconditions: Health on.
cases.steps: Privacy tab actions
cases.expected: Withdrawal immediate; log shows who/what/when IST; full record PDF downloads; delete hides records (retained).
